sehemu: Part II: Members of Parliament, Constituencies and Election of Members
jina: Members to submit statements of property
maudhui: (1) Every Member of Parliament shall submit to the Speaker two copies of a formal statement containing particulars of his property and, where applicable, the property of his spouse. The statement shall be made in the prescribed form provided for by a law enacted by Parliament and shall be submitted from time to time as required by that law. (2) The Speaker shall submit to the Ethics Commissioner one copy of every formal statement submitted to him. (3) Parliament may enact a law making provision for the custody of statements of property submitted by Members and for ensuring that unauthorized or unconcerned persons do not have access to such statements.
